payload.text: kovacs is a pristine brew-only install for Utilz and Intent (hv's ruling of 19 Oct, relayed by kovacs-sysadm). Since 20 Oct, Utilz 2.14.1 is brew-installed there from the tap: doctor 7/7, and whence -a utilz finds only /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/utilz. The leftover ~/Devel/prj/Utilz checkout and its 16 ~/bin links are gone; hv ran the removal in kovacs-sysadm's session, and its 24 commits on no remote are held here on backup/pre-scrub-20260907. There is no dev checkout there and no link from a PATH dir into one. A kovacs test leg lives in its own /var/tmp run dir, pip's cache included, is removed once its logs are back, and ships its own tree. rustup's stable there is 1.99.1, CI's toolchain, with clippy and rustfmt (vc's decision 49; rustup update stable on hv's approval, 20 Oct). brew's rust 1.99.1, the formula's build dependency, comes first on PATH, so each cargo leg puts ~/.cargo/bin first and prints rustc -V, cargo -V, cargo clippy -V and rustfmt -V. Nothing for acceptance (xvfb, a browser, node) is installed. A fresh Homebrew 7 refuses an untrusted tap: brew trust matthewsinclair/utilz goes between the tap and the install.
